\\n\\ud83d\\udcdd Walkthrough\\n\\n## Walkthrough\\n\\nThis pull request adds new visual effect infrastructure for a fighting game board, including two new C# MonoBehaviour components (BoardOutlineManager and BoardVFXCell) that manage edge highlighting for active combo tiles, organized supporting assets (materials, prefabs, shaders, scenes), and third-party VFX packages with metadata files.\\n\\n## Changes\\n\\n| Cohort / File(s) | Change Summary |\\n|---|---|\\n| **Material Assets**

`Assets/FightingGame_TMP/Scenes.meta`, `Assets/FightingGame_TMP/Scenes/Board_ComboUI_Vfx.unity.meta` | Added scene metadata files for new combo UI visual effects scene. |\\n| **Shader Assets**
`Assets/FightingGame_TMP/shaders/FireElectricBeam.shadergraph.meta`, `Assets/FightingGame_TMP/shaders/UI_GlowGradient.shadergraph.meta` | Added ShaderGraph asset meta files with ScriptedImporter configuration. |\\n| **Board Outline Management**
`Assets/FightingGame_TMP/Scripts/BoardOutlineManager.cs`, `Assets/FightingGame_TMP/Scripts/BoardOutlineManager.cs.meta` | New MonoBehaviour managing board outline visuals: creates 2D grid of cell visuals, subscribes to combo/board events, computes edge visibility based on neighbor tiles, and updates border display. Handles initialization, refresh, and per-cell border state management. |\\n| **Board VFX Cell**
`Assets/FightingGame_TMP/Scripts/BoardVFXCell.cs`, `Assets/FightingGame_TMP/Scripts/BoardVFXCell.cs.meta` | New MonoBehaviour component holding references to four directional VFX GameObjects (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) with methods to toggle individual borders and hide all visuals. |\\n| **Third-Party VFX Assets**

OnComboUpdated, OnBoardChanged\\n BOM->>BOM: After Start: Initialize()\\n activate BOM\\n BOM->>Board: Get Board dimensions\\n BOM->>Board: Create 2D grid of cells
matching Board size\\n BOM->>BVC: Instantiate cell visuals
as container children\\n loop For each cell\\n BOM->>Board: GetIndexScreenPosition(row, col)\\n BOM->>BVC: SetPosition & transform\\n end\\n BOM->>BVC: HideAll() for all cells\\n deactivate BOM\\n \\n EventSys->>BOM: OnComboUpdated fired\\n BOM->>BOM: RefreshBoard()\\n activate BOM\\n BOM->>GC: Get active combo tiles\\n loop For each board cell\\n BOM->>BOM: Check if in active combo\\n alt In combo\\n BOM->>BOM: Compute edge visibility

**Snapshot date (cutoff):** February 28, 2026
**Prepared for:** company wind-down / final source-control provenance handoff
**Owners of this effort:** Leonard Hayes (totals) & Arthur Blake (preservation)

## What this is and why we are preserving it

As HarmonyGames winds down and we hand over the last of the company's
access, this pack captures the **source-control history** of our two
private code repositories so it does not become a loose end once access
is transferred. It is a **preservation record, not a technical/code-quality
review** — the goal is that every pull request can be found again and that
its review and lifecycle history is documented before the accounts go away.

Scope — every open and closed PR, as of the Feb 28, 2026 cutoff, in:

- `harmonygames-Games/Combo-Fighters` — 37 PRs
- `harmonygames-Games/game-of-dominoes-backend` — 79 PRs

## The Register

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/b7a94ecff170ac1f6b618805/edit

- **Register tab** — one row per PR, grouped by repo and PR number (116 rows).
  Each row carries enough to find the PR again (repo, number, title, state,
  author, direct PR URL, head→base branch, created/closed dates), the
  Feb 28 cutoff, a completion marker, and the gap flags.
- For **every PR** the five record types are kept separate:
  1. Commits (count + first/last SHA)
  2. Submitted reviews (count, dates, people, review states)
  3. Inline diff comments (count, dates, people, file paths)
  4. General PR conversation (count, dates, people)
  5. Lifecycle history (event count, dates, event types)
  Where a record type has nothing, the cell reads **NONE FOUND** so it is
  clear the item was checked. Undated lifecycle events are still counted but
  do not set the date range. A PR is only marked complete once all five
  record types have a result.
- **Totals tab** — PR counts and per-flag counts for Combo-Fighters, the
  dominoes backend, and both combined, plus a legend of the methodology.

### Gap flags (record gaps, not code-quality judgments)

- `NO_SUBMITTED_REVIEW` — no submitted PR review on record
- `NO_INLINE_REVIEW_DISCUSSION` — no inline diff comments on record
- `NO_GENERAL_CONVERSATION` — no general PR conversation on record
- `NO_REVIEW_REQUEST_EVENT` — no `review_requested` event in lifecycle history
- `MULTI_COMMIT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL` — more than one commit and no `APPROVED`
  review anywhere in submitted reviews
- `NONE` — no gaps apply
